Definition: to shoot out horns; figuratively, rays
BiblicalUsage: To shoot out horns is the word for Moses' shining face: when he came down from the mount, the skin of his face shone while he talked with God, and the children of Israel saw that the skin of Moses' face shone, and the psalmist says praise shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the shining as the mark of a man who has been with God, and the horns as the mark of the offering that cannot compare with praise.
